_comment: 顧客名寄せ統合キー behavioral fixture (D-3201). 検査数字 = modulus-11 weights 2..7 cycling from rightmost (GOLDEN) vs modulus-10 Luhn (START). cif_no is the 10-digit key body. Rows 1-5 are keyable (status 01) and GOLDEN!=START -> DISCRIMINATE. Row 6 (1234567890) is keyable but golden==start==3 -> control (both arms pass). Row 7 (status 08) is 対象外(S), cd 0 in both -> control. expect_cd are GOLDEN values.
